recommended_actions: Force a password reset and end every session for accounts that signed in during the burst.
For the web app, turn on a bot check for sign-in and rate-limit by device fingerprint as well as address.
Encourage two-step verification and check new passwords against known breached passwords.
limitations: Single log source (app-security): no other log corroborates it
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-008: A busy site, where this many different users fail in an hour on an ordinary day
Possible benign cause for PRH-AUTH-008: A sign-in outage or a forced password reset that makes many users fail at once
